title: AudioRecorder Stop Error Handling
requirements: Change AudioRecorder.stop() to throw RecorderError.notRecording (LocalizedError) when no recording is active — remove the URL(fileURLWithPath: "") sentinel return
RecordingViewModel.stop() must call recorder.stop() in try/catch; on RecorderError.notRecording it returns early without emitting completedEntry and resets to the not-recording UI state
acceptance_criteria: start() then stop() returns a valid entry with non-empty audioPath
stop() without start() throws RecorderError.notRecording, produces no completedEntry, and produces no UI side-effects
A grep for URL(filePath: "") in Sources/ returns no matches in production code paths
